CalibrationReport.description: How well one judge agrees with human labels on one rubric version.
CalibrationReport.title: CalibrationReport

Confusion.description: Judge verdicts against the reference labels on the same items.
Confusion.title: Confusion

DiffStep.description: One step as the diff sees it: the common ground of live and stored steps.
DiffStep.title: DiffStep

ErrorInfo.description: An exception captured from a call or from the agent itself.
ErrorInfo.title: ErrorInfo

FieldChange.description:
One field that differs between the two sides of a ``changed`` row.

``path`` is ``request.<key>`` for a top-level request key, ``request`` for a
request that is not an object, ``request.messages[-1]`` for a model call's
newest message (``request.messages[<i>]`` for the first earlier message that
differs, ``request.messages`` when only the count does), ``response`` or
``error``. A key or message one side lacks is ``None`` with its ``*_present``
flag false, which tells it apart from a genuine ``null``.
FieldChange.title: FieldChange

FlakePoint.description: One scenario's estimate in one ``replay flake`` report: a point on its trend.
FlakePoint.title: FlakePoint

FlakeSettings.description: How often to repeat each scenario and how to decide on the outcomes.
FlakeSettings.title: FlakeSettings

FlipStats.description: How often a perturbation that should not matter changed the judge's verdict.
FlipStats.title: FlipStats

GroupStats.description: Judge leniency on one group of items, measured against the reference labels.
GroupStats.title: GroupStats

ProbeResult.description:
One bias probe. ``flips`` is set for perturbation probes (position, verbosity),
``groups`` for the self-preference comparison; ``skipped`` says why neither is.
ProbeResult.title: ProbeResult

RunOutcome.description: One repeated run of a scenario.
RunOutcome.title: RunOutcome

SelfConsistency.description: How much the judge agrees with itself over repeated runs on the same items.
SelfConsistency.title: SelfConsistency
